summary: Transient Windows junction error in agy binary prevented Gemini requalification; passed on retry. Root cause: agy 1.3.0 could not traverse C:\Users\ahazan\.gemini junction (to D:\ai-data\gemini) due to untrusted-mount-point error. Not a code defect. Requalification now passes; Gemini is installed-healthy.
details:
Root cause: Transient Windows filesystem error. The agy binary (1.3.0) failed to traverse the directory junction at C:\Users\ahazan\.gemini (junction to D:\ai-data\gemini) during the original requalification attempt at 2026-10-05 22:26:48 EDT. Error: 'The path cannot be traversed because it contains an untrusted mount point' when opening C:/Users/ahazan/.gemini/antigravity-cli/installation_id.

This is NOT a code/config defect in popcre/ai-devops. The wrapper code correctly detected staleness (wrapper SHA and agy both changed from the prior qualification) and ran the canary. The failure was in the agy binary's interaction with the Windows junction at that moment.

Evidence of transient nature:
1. Failure artifact: ~/.local/state/ai-devops/gemini/failures/codex--qual-20261006T022622Z-3636821-20261006T022649Z-3636841-provider-request.stderr shows 'untrusted mount point' error
2. agy CLI log at ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/cli.log shows successful authentication and model fetch at Oct 6 07:35 EDT (hours after failure)
3. Manual agy --sandbox test succeeded
4. Requalification retry passed: wrapper 2c09914447dd5dbd45fa242993863282be9858d588c67be2f89f636aea1b1cbe, agy 1.3.0, model gemini-3.8-flash-high

Resolution: Requalification passed on retry. Gemini status is now installed-healthy / usable:true. No code changes required. The qualification record at ~/.local/state/ai-devops/review-quarantine/gemini-live-qualified.json now includes the new version (4th entry in versions array).
